questions.content:
一、

解析:(1)(1.1)有麦克斯韦速度分布律

$$f_{0}\left( \vec{\nu} \right) = \left( \frac{m}{2\pi kT} \right)^{\frac{3}{2}}e^{-\frac{mv^{2}}{2kT}}\tag{1}$$

$$\Gamma = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} \int_{0}^{+\infty} n f_0(\vec{v}) v_x \mathrm{d}v_x \mathrm{d}v_y \mathrm{d}v_z = n \sqrt{\frac{kT}{2 \pi m}}\tag{2}$$

(1.2)

$$f ( v ) = \frac { \int _ { 0 } ^ { 2 \pi } \int _ { 0 } ^ { \frac { \pi } { 2 } } f _ { 0 } ( v ) v \cos \theta \sin \theta \mathrm { d } \theta \mathrm { d } \varphi v ^ { 2 } } { \sqrt { \frac { k T } { 2 \pi m } } }\tag{3}$$

积分得到

$$f(\nu) = \frac{1}{2} \left( \frac{m}{kT} \right)^2 e^{-\frac{mv^2}{2kT}} \nu^3\tag{4}$$

(1.3)

$$f \left( \theta \right) \mathrm{d} \theta = \frac{\int_{0}^{2 \pi} \int_{0}^{+ \infty} f_{0} \left( \nu \right) \nu \cos \theta \sin \theta \mathrm{d} \theta \mathrm{d} \varphi \nu^{2} \mathrm{d} \nu}{\sqrt{\frac{kT}{2 \pi m}}} = 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta \mathrm{d} \theta\tag{5}$$

即

$$f(\theta) = \sin 2\theta\tag{6}$$

(2)(2.1)对频率小于ν的电磁波，则应有

$$\left( {k_{x}}^{2} + {k_{y}}^{2} + {k_{z}}^{2} \right) {c}^{2} \leq \left( 2\pi \nu \right)^{2}\tag{7}$$

代入得

$$n_{1}^{2}+n_{2}^{2}+n_{3}^{2}\leq \left ( \frac{vL}{c} \right ) ^{2}\tag{8}$$

(2.2)频率低于ν的电磁波所具有的状态数

$$N(\nu)=\frac{4\pi}{3}\cdot2\left(\frac{\nu L}{c}\right)^{3}=\frac{8\pi}{3}\left(\frac{\nu L}{c}\right)^{3}\tag{9}$$

$$g(v) = \frac{dN(v)}{dy} = \frac{8\pi L^{3}}{c^{3}}v^{2}\tag{10}$$

(2.3)分析可知

$$J = \frac{\int_{0}^{+ \infty}\int_{0}^{2\pi}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}g\left( \nu \right)\frac{h\nu}{\left\lbrack e^{\frac{h\nu}{kT} - 1}\right\rbrack}c\cos\theta\sin\theta d\theta d\varphi d\nu}{4\pi L^{3}}\tag{11}$$

得到

$$\frac{2\pi k^{4}}{c^{2}h^{3}}\int_{0}^{\infty}\frac{x^{3}\mathrm{d}x}{e^{x}-1}T^{4}\tag{12}$$

(3)(3.1)黑体辐射分布在θ→θ+dθ范围的能量

$$\mathrm{d}J = \sigma T^{4} \frac{\sin \theta \cos \theta \mathrm{d}\theta}{\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin \theta \cos \theta \mathrm{d}\theta}\tag{13}$$

$$\mathrm{d}J = \sigma T^{4} \sin 2\theta \mathrm{d}\theta\tag{14}$$

(3.2)当球壳向内球辐射能量时，有效的辐射百分比为

$$\int_{0}^{\arcsin\frac{r}{R}}\sin2\theta d\theta=\left(\frac{r}{R}\right)^{2}\tag{15}$$

而其余1 $- \left( { \frac { r } { R } } \right) ^ { 2 }$ 部分的辐射将被辐射到球壳上并再次反射到内球上，设内球的出射总能流为 $J_{ 出 }$ ，接收的总能流为 $J _ { 1 \lambda } ,$ 外球壳同理，则有

$$J_{1出} = (1 - \varepsilon_{1})J_{1入} + \varepsilon_{1}4\pi r^{2}\sigma T_{1}^{4}\tag{16}$$

$$J_{1入} = \frac{r^2}{R^2} J_{2出}\tag{17}$$

$$J_{2出} = \varepsilon_{2}4\pi R^{2}\sigma T_{2}^{4} + (1 - \varepsilon_{2})J_{2入}\tag{18}$$

$$J_{2\lambda} = J_{1出} + \left(1 - \frac{r^2}{R^2}\right)J_{2出}\tag{19}$$

由热平衡方程得

$$J_{1出} = Q + J_{1入}\tag{20}$$

$$J_{2出} + \varepsilon_{2} \sigma \left( T_{2}^{4} - T_{0}^{4} \right) \cdot 4 \pi R^{2} = J_{2入}\tag{21}$$

联立解得

$$T_{1} = \left[ \frac{1 + \frac{\left( 2 - \varepsilon_{2} \right) \varepsilon_{1} \lambda}{\varepsilon_{2}}}{4 \pi R^{2} \sigma \lambda \varepsilon_{1}} Q + T_{0}^{4} \right]^{\frac{1}{4}}\tag{22}$$

$$T_{2} = \left( \frac{Q}{4 \pi R^{2} \varepsilon_{2} \sigma} + T_{0}^{4} \right)^{\frac{1}{4}}\tag{23}$$

其中 $\lambda   =   \frac { r ^ { 2 } } { R ^ { 2 } }   .$

评分标准:

第(1)问:10分；(1.1)3分；(2)3分；(1.2)3分；(4)3分；(1.3)4分；(6)4分；

第(2)间:15分；(2.1)5分；(8)5分；(2.2)5分；(10)5分；(2.3)5分；(12)5分；

第(3)问:25分；(3.1)5分；(14)5分；(3.2)20分；(15)-(19)各2分；(20)(21)3分，(22)(23)2分；

解析:(1)

$$| E \rangle = \binom{\cos \theta}{\sin \theta} E_0\tag{1}$$

(2)对于线偏光 $\begin{pmatrix} E_{x} \\ 0 \end{pmatrix}$ 易得

$$\left( \boldsymbol { E } _ { x } \quad 0 \right) \left( \begin{aligned} \boldsymbol { I } _ { x x } \quad \boldsymbol { I } _ { x y } \\ \boldsymbol { I } _ { y x } \quad \boldsymbol { I } _ { x y } \end{aligned} \right) \left( \begin{aligned} \boldsymbol { E } _ { x } \\ 0 \end{aligned} \right) = \boldsymbol { I } _ { x x } \boldsymbol { E } _ { x }\tag{2}$$

又由光学知识易知

$$I_{xx}E_{x} = E_{x}\cos^{2}\theta\tag{3}$$

得

$$I _ { x x } = \cos ^ { 2 } \theta\tag{4}$$

由对称性易得

$$I _ { y y } = \sin ^ { 2 } \theta\tag{5}$$

$$I_{yx} = I_{xy} = \sin \theta \cos \theta\tag{6}$$

(3)用积分代替对偏振态的求和有

$$\int_{0}^{2 \pi} I_{0} d \theta \binom{\cos \theta}{\sin \theta} = I_{0} \binom{0}{0}\tag{7}$$

即求和结果为 $\left( \begin{matrix} { 0 } \\ { 0 } \\ \end{matrix} \right)$

(4)

$$P(\theta) = \begin{pmatrix} \cos \theta \\ \sin \theta \end{pmatrix} (\cos \theta, \sin \theta) = \begin{pmatrix} \cos^2 \theta & \sin \theta \cos \theta \\ \sin \theta \cos \theta & \sin^2 \theta \end{pmatrix}\tag{8}$$

(5)左旋光

$$P_{L}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\binom{1}{-i}\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\binom{1\quad i}{}=\left(\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2}&\quad\frac{i}{2}\\-\frac{i}{2}&\quad\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}\right)\tag{9}$$

而

$$P_{_R} = \begin{pmatrix} \dfrac{1}{2} & \dfrac{-i}{2} \\ \dfrac{i}{2} & \dfrac{1}{2} \end{pmatrix}\tag{10}$$

(6）对于自然光，其相干性矩阵即为各线偏光的偏振矩阵求和，归一化后

$$P_{0} = \int d\theta \left( \begin{array}{cc} \cos^{2} \theta & \sin \theta \cos \theta \\ \sin \theta \cos \theta & \sin^{2} \theta \end{array} \right) \frac{1}{2\pi} = \left( \begin{array}{cc} \frac{1}{2} & 0 \\ 0 & \frac{1}{2} \\ 0 & \frac{1}{2} \end{array} \right)\tag{11}$$

(7)其光强的角分布

$$\begin{aligned}\langle I \rangle = & \operatorname{Tr} \left( \begin{matrix} \cos^2 \theta & \sin \theta \cos \theta \\ \sin \theta \cos \theta & \sin^2 \theta \end{matrix} \right) \left( \begin{matrix} \cos^2 \varphi & \sin \varphi \cos \varphi \\ \sin \varphi \cos \varphi & \sin^2 \varphi \end{matrix} \right) \\= & \cos \left( \theta - \varphi \right)^2\end{aligned}$$

(8)对左旋光

(12)

$$I_{L}=\mathrm{Tr}\left(\frac{1}{2}\frac{i}{2}\right)\left(\cos^{2}\theta\sin\theta\cos\theta\right)=\frac{1}{2}\tag{13}$$

对右旋光同样有

$$I _ {   R }   =   \frac { 1 } { 2 }$$

对自然光

(14)

$$\mathrm{Tr}\left\{\left(\frac{1}{2} \quad 0\right)\left(\cos^{2} \theta \quad \sin \theta \cos \theta\right)\right\}=\frac{1}{2}\tag{15}$$

(9)对于左旋光

$$\det P_{L}=\frac{1}{4}-\frac{1}{4}=0\tag{16}$$

同样

$$\operatorname* { d e t } P _ { R } = 0\tag{17}$$

而

$$\operatorname* { d e t } P _ { 0 } = { \frac { 1 } { 4 } }\tag{18}$$

可见虽然自然光与圆偏振光通过偏振片后光强相同，但圆偏振光的相干矩阵行列式为0，而自然光的相干矩阵的非对角元为0。

(10)将该部分偏振光分解为完全偏振光与完全非偏振光之和

$$P = \begin{pmatrix} d & 0 \\ 0 & d \end{pmatrix} + \begin{pmatrix} a-d  & \overline{c} \\ c  &  b-d  \end{pmatrix}\tag{19}$$

根据完全偏振光的矩阵性质可得

$$(a - d)(b - d) = c\overline{c}\tag{20}$$

即得

$$d = \frac{1}{2} \left( (a + b) - \sqrt{(a + b)^{2} - 4(ab - c\overline{c})} \right)\tag{21}$$

则偏振度

$$V = \frac{I_{偏}}{I_{总}} = \sqrt{1 - 4\frac{ab - c\overline{c}}{\left( a + b \right)^{2}}}\tag{22}$$

当偏振度为0时，则有

$$a = b , c = \overline{c} = 0\tag{23}$$

评分标准:

第(1)问:2分；(1)2分；

第(2)问:3分；(4)(5)(6)1分；

第(3)问:2分；(7)2分；

第(4)问:3分；(8)3分；

第(5)问:4分；(9)(10)2分；

第(6)问:3分；(11)3分；

第(7)问:4分；(12)4分；

第(8)问:6分；(13)(14)(15)2分；

第(9)问:10分；(16)(17)(18)2分；文字说明4分；

第(10)问:13分；(19)4分；(20)(21)2分；(22)3分；(23)2分；

questions.content:
三、

解析:(1)使用负质量法

$$x_{c}=\frac{\rho\pi\left(\frac{R}{2}\right)^{2}l\frac{R}{2}}{\rho\left[\left(\pi R^{2}-\pi\left(\frac{R}{2}\right)^{2}\right)\right]}=\frac{R}{6}\tag{1}$$

(2) 对实心柱

$$I_{c_1} = I_1 + \rho \pi R^2 l \cdot x_c^2$$

$$I_{2} = \frac{1}{2} \left[ \rho \pi \left( \frac{R}{2} \right)^{2} l \right] \left( \frac{R}{2} \right)^{2}$$

$$I_{C_2} = I_2 + \rho \pi \left( \frac{R}{2} \right)^2 I \cdot \left( \frac{R}{6} + \frac{R}{2} \right)^2\tag{2}$$

$$I_{c}=I_{C_{1}}-I_{C_{2}}=\frac{37}{96}\rho\pi R^{4}$$

$$I_{1} = \frac{1}{2} \left( \rho \pi R^{2} l \right) \cdot R^{2}$$

又 $m = \rho \cdot \frac{3}{4} \pi R^2 l$ 得到

$$I_{C} = \frac{37}{72} m R^{2}\tag{3}$$

(3)由于题中没有明确A，O，质心C的位次，所以要分别讨论。

![](data/images/2023-ed70e37e/2023-量子-答案_part01-33.jpg)

①质心C在 $O, A$ 中间:完全非弹性碰撞，碰后绕着A点转，对A点，角动量守恒有

$$I_{A} \omega = I_{C} \frac{v_{0}}{|DC|} + m v_{0} \sin \beta \frac{5}{6} R\tag{4}$$

能量要求:

$$\frac{1}{2} I_A \omega^2 \geq mg \cdot (|AC| + h) - mg \left( |AC| \cos \theta + h \right)\tag{5}$$

式中，

$$I_{A}=I_{C}+m\cdot \left | AC \right | ^{2} =\frac{29}{24}mR^{2}\tag{6}$$

此外，还要考虑力学关系。A点处的弹力必须始终大于零。又容易知道初始时弹力是最小值。考虑碰撞结束后的一瞬间:

$$N_{A}=mg\cos\theta-m\omega^{2}\left|AC\right|\geq0\tag{7}$$

现在来处理几何关系。

$$90^{\circ}-\beta=\alpha+\theta\Rightarrow\sin\beta=\cos(\alpha+\theta)\tag{8}$$

$$\cos \theta = 1 - \frac{h}{R}, \quad \sin \theta = \sqrt{\frac{2h}{R} - \frac{h^2}{R^2}}\tag{9}$$

$$\left|CD\right|^{2}=\left|OD\right|^{2}+\left|OC\right|^{2}-2\left|OD\right|\cdot\left|OC\right|\cdot\cos\theta=\frac{25}{36}R^{2}\cdot\left(1+\frac{12}{25}\frac{h}{R}\right)\tag{10}$$

得

$$\left|CD\right|=\frac{5R}{6}\sqrt{1+\frac{12}{25}\frac{h}{R}}\tag{11}$$

$$\sin \alpha = \frac{\left| \overrightarrow{OC} \right|}{\left| \overrightarrow{CD} \right|} \cdot \sin \theta = \frac{\sin \theta}{5} \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{12h}{25R}}}\tag{12}$$

$$\cos \alpha = \frac{\left| \overrightarrow{OD} \right|^{2} + \left| \overrightarrow{DC} \right|^{2} - \left| \overrightarrow{OC} \right|^{2}}{2\left| \overrightarrow{OD} \right| \cdot \left| \overrightarrow{DC} \right|} = \frac{1 + \frac{h}{5R}}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{12h}{25R}}}\tag{13}$$

为简化，记 $\frac{h}{R} = x$

$$\sin \beta = \cos \alpha \cos \theta - \sin \alpha \sin \theta = \frac{5 - 6x}{5\sqrt{1 + \frac{12}{25}x}}\tag{14}$$

$$v_{0} \geq \frac{\sqrt{290(25 + 12x)xgR}}{3(29 - 20x)}\tag{15}$$

又N≥0

$$v_{0} \leq \frac{29}{29 - 20x} \sqrt{\frac{(1 - x)(25 + 12x)gR}{30}}\tag{16}$$

为有解.有

$$\frac{\sqrt{290(25 + 12x)x}}{3(29 - 20x)} \leq \frac{29}{29 - 20x}\sqrt{\frac{(1 - x)(25 + 12x)}{30}}\tag{17}$$

得到

$$\frac { h } { R } \leq \frac { 8 7 } { 1 8 7 }\tag{18}$$

②质心C不在 $O, A$ 中间: 方程相同，但是 $\left| A C \right| = \frac { 7 } { 6 } R$

![](data/images/2023-ed70e37e/2023-量子-答案_part01-34.jpg)

$$I_{A}=\frac{15}{8}mR^{2}\tag{19}$$

$$\sin \beta = \cos(\theta - \alpha)\tag{20}$$

$$| \mathrm{CD} |^{2} = | \mathrm{OC} |^{2} + | \mathrm{OD} |^{2} + 2| \mathrm{OD} | \cdot | \mathrm{OC} | \cos \theta = \frac{49}{36} R^{2} \left( 1 - \frac{12}{49} \frac{h}{R} \right)\tag{21}$$

$$\left|CD\right|=\frac{7R}{6}\sqrt{1-\frac{12}{49}\frac{h}{R}}\tag{22}$$

$$\sin \alpha = \frac{\left| \mathrm{OC} \right|}{\left| \mathrm{CD} \right|} \cdot \sin \theta = \frac{\sin \theta}{7R} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - \frac{12}{49} \frac{h}{R}}}\tag{23}$$

$$\cos \alpha = \frac{7 - \frac{h}{R}}{7\sqrt{1 - \frac{12}{49}\frac{h}{R}}}\tag{24}$$

$$\sin \beta = \frac{7 - 6x}{7\sqrt{1 - \frac{12}{49}x}}, x = \frac{h}{R}\tag{25}$$

$$v_{0} \geq \frac{\sqrt{70x\left ( 49 - 12x \right ) gR}}{45 - 28x}\tag{26}$$

$$v_{0} \leq \frac{15\sqrt{42(1 - x)(49 - 12x)gR}}{14(45 - 28x)}\tag{27}$$

要求

$$\frac { h } { R } \leq \frac { 1 3 5 } { 3 3 1 }\tag{28}$$

(4)易知最容易产生滑动的时刻恰是碰撞后的瞬间。此时台阶的弹力已经给出，来求摩擦力。由质心运动定理

$$-m\ddot{\theta} \cdot |AC| = f - mg\sin\theta\tag{29}$$

能量守恒

$$\frac{1}{2} I_A \omega^2 + mg \left( \left| AC \right| \cos \theta + h \right) = C\tag{30}$$

求导:

$$- I_{A}\ddot{\theta} + mg|AC|\cdot\sin\theta = 0\tag{31}$$

$$\ddot{\theta} = \frac{mg}{I_{A}} \left| AC \right| \cdot \sin \theta\tag{32}$$

$$f = mg \sin \theta - m \cdot \frac{mg}{I_A} \left| A C \right|^2 \sin \theta\tag{33}$$

$$f = \arcsin \theta \frac{I_c}{I_A}\tag{34}$$

对情况①，有 $\frac{I_{c}}{I_{A}}=\frac{37}{87}$ 可以得到

$$\omega = \frac{6}{145} \frac{29 - 20x}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{12}{25}x}} \frac{v_0}{R}\tag{37}$$

$$\mu \geqslant \frac{\frac{37}{87}\sqrt{2x - x^{2}}}{1 - x - \frac{30}{841}\frac{\left( 29 - 20x \right)^{2}}{25 + 12x}\frac{v_{0}^{2}}{gR}}\tag{38}$$

$$\omega=\frac{2}{105}\frac{45-28x}{\sqrt{1-\frac{12}{49}x}}\frac{v_{0}}{R}\tag{39}$$

$$\mu \geqslant \frac{\frac{37}{135}\sqrt{2x - x^{2}}}{1 - x - \frac{14}{675}\frac{\left( 45 - 28x \right)^{2}}{49 - 12x}\frac{v_{0}^{2}}{gR}}\tag{40}$$

tags: 近代物理/狭义相对论/洛伦兹变换/能量与动量

questions.content:
四、

解析:(1)在动心系中总能量

$$E_{0}=\frac{E_{v}+m_{n}c^{2}-\beta E_{v}}{\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}}\tag{1}$$

其中

$$\beta = \frac{E_{v}}{E_{v} + m_{n}c^{2}}\tag{2}$$

即

$$E_{0} = \sqrt{\left( E_{v} + m_{n}c^{2} \right)^{2} - E_{v}^{2}}\tag{3}$$

临界时

$$E _ { 0 } = \left( m _ { p } + m _ { \tau } \right) c ^ { 2 }\tag{4}$$

得

$$E_{y0} = 3453.3  MeV\tag{5}$$

(2)若考虑一个动心系中动量为 $p _ { \mathrm { t } }$ 的τ子，其与入射方向夹角为 $\theta _ { \mathrm { r } }$ ，在地面系中动量为 $p _ { 2 }$夹角为 $\theta _ { z }$ ，则由相对论能动量变换得

$$p_{1}\cos\theta_{1}=\frac{p_{2}\cos\theta_{2}-\beta E_{2}}{\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}}\tag{6}$$

$$E_{1}=\frac{E_{2}-\beta p_{2}c\cos\theta_{2}}{\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}}\tag{7}$$

$$E_{2}^{2}=m_{\tau}^{2}c^{4}+p_{2}^{2}c^{2}\tag{8}$$

β为动心系的洛伦兹因子，将上述各式对 $\cos \theta _ { \mathrm { t } }$ 求导得

$$p_{1} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}}\left( \frac{\mathrm{d}p_{2}}{\mathrm{d}\cos\theta_{1}}\cos\theta_{2} + p_{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}\cos\theta_{2}}{\mathrm{d}\cos\theta_{1}} - \beta\frac{\mathrm{d}E_{2}}{\mathrm{d}\cos\theta_{1}} \right)\tag{9}$$

$$0 = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 1 - \beta ^ { 2 } } } \left( \frac { \mathrm { d } E _ { 2 } } { \mathrm { d } \cos \theta _ { 1 } } - \beta c \frac { \mathrm { d } p _ { 2 } } { \mathrm { d } \cos \theta _ { 1 } } \cos \theta _ { 2 } - \beta c p _ { 2 } \frac { \mathrm { d } \cos \theta _ { 2 } } { \mathrm { d } \cos \theta _ { 1 } } \right)\tag{10}$$

$$E_{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}E_{2}}{\mathrm{d}\cos\theta_{1}}=c^{2}p_{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}p_{2}}{\mathrm{d}\cos\theta_{1}}\tag{11}$$

解得

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}\cos\theta_{2}}{\mathrm{d}\cos\theta_{1}}=\frac{p_{1}\left(1-\frac{E_{2}\beta}{p_{2}c}\cos\theta_{2}\right)}{p_{2}\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}}\tag{12}$$

在动心系中τ子向各方向出射的概率函数为

$$N_{1}(\theta_{1},\varphi_{1}) = \frac{1}{4\pi}\tag{13}$$

φ为球坐标下的极角，由概率守恒，则应有

$$N _ { 1 } \left( \theta _ { 1 } , \varphi _ { 1 } \right) \mathrm { d } \Omega _ { 1 } = N _ { 2 } \left( \theta _ { 2 } , \varphi _ { 2 } \right) \mathrm { d } \Omega _ { 2 }\tag{14}$$

由对称性

$$\mathrm { d } \boldsymbol { \varphi } _ { 1 } = \mathrm { d } \boldsymbol { \varphi } _ { 2 }\tag{15}$$

则得

$$N_{2}\left( \theta_{2},\varphi_{2} \right) = N_{1}\left( \theta_{1},\varphi_{1} \right)\frac{d\cos\theta_{1}}{d\cos\theta_{2}} = \frac{1}{4\pi}\frac{p_{2}\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}}{p_{1}\left( 1 - \frac{\beta E_{2}}{p_{2}c}\cos\theta_{2} \right)}\tag{16}$$

而动心系中，总能量

$$E_{c} = \sqrt{\left(E_{0} + m_{n}c^{2}\right)^{2} - E_{0}^{2}}\tag{17}$$

故对τ-子有

$$\sqrt{p_{1}^{2}c^{2}+m_{r}^{2}c^{4}}+\sqrt{p_{1}^{2}c^{2}+m_{p}^{2}c^{4}}=E_{c}\tag{18}$$

即得

$$p_{1}=\frac{1}{c}\sqrt{\frac{\left(E_{c}^{2}+m_{p}^{2}c^{4}-m_{r}^{2}c^{4}\right)^{2}}{4E_{c}^{2}}-m_{p}^{2}c^{4}}\tag{19}$$

由相对论变换

$$E_{1}=\frac{E_{2}-\beta p_{2}c\cos\theta_{2}}{\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}}\tag{20}$$

又

$$E_{2} = \sqrt{p_{2}^{2}c^{2} + m_{\tau}^{2}c^{4}}\tag{21}$$

得

$$p_{2}c = \frac{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}E_{1}\beta\cos\theta_{2} + \sqrt{\left( 1 - \beta^{2} \right)E_{1}^{2} - \left( 1 - \beta^{2}\cos^{2}\theta_{2} \right)m_{r}^{2}c^{4}}}{1 - \beta^{2}\cos^{2}\theta_{2}}\tag{22}$$

代入即得题目所求

$$p(\theta) = \frac{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}E_{1}\beta\cos\theta + \sqrt{\left( 1 - \beta^{2} \right)E_{1}^{2} - \left( 1 - \beta^{2}\cos^{2}\theta \right)m_{r}^{2}c^{4}}}{\left( 1 - \beta^{2}\cos^{2}\theta \right)c}\tag{23}$$

$$N(\theta) = \frac{1}{4\pi} \frac{p(\theta)c\sqrt{1 - \beta^2}}{\sqrt{E_1^2 - m_\tau^2c^4}\left(1 - \frac{\beta \sqrt{p(\theta)^2c^2 + m_\tau^2c^4}}{p(\theta)c}\cos\theta\right)}\tag{24}$$

式中

$$E_{1}=\frac{\left(E_{0}+m_{n} c^{2}\right)^{2}-E_{0}^{2}-m_{p}^{2} c^{4}+m_{r}^{2} c^{4}}{2 \sqrt{\left(E_{0}+m_{n} c^{2}\right)^{2}-E_{0}^{2}}}, \beta=\frac{E_{0}}{E_{0}+m_{n} c^{2}}\tag{25}$$

评分标准:

第(1)问:10分；(1)4分；(3)(4)(5)2分；

第(2)问:30分；(6)(7)3分；(8)2分；(12)4分；(13)(14)(15)2分；(16)1分；(18)(19)(20)2分；(23)3分；(24)2分；

questions.content:
五、

解析:设容器内小液滴的质量分数为x，则体系的比熵

$$S = (1 - x)S_{1} + xS_{2}\tag{1}$$

其中 $S_{1}$ 为水蒸气的比熵，$S_{2}$ 为水液态的比熵，同样的比体积

$$V = (1 - x)V_{1} + xV_{2}\tag{2}$$

由声速公式

$$v_{s} = \sqrt{\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial \rho}\right)_{s}}\tag{3}$$

在绝热条件下

$$\mathrm{d}S = (1 - x)\mathrm{d}S_{1} + x\mathrm{d}S_{2} + (S_{2} - S_{1})\mathrm{d}x = 0\tag{4}$$

由克拉伯龙方程

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}p}{\mathrm{d}T}=\frac{L}{T\left(V_{1}-V_{2}\right)}\tag{5}$$

比汽化热

$$L = T \left( S_{1} - S_{2} \right)\tag{6}$$

$$\mathrm{d}V = \mathrm{d}\left( \frac{1}{\rho} \right) = - \frac{\mathrm{d}\rho}{\rho^{2}} = (1 - x)\mathrm{d}V_{1} + x\mathrm{d}V_{2} + (V_{2} - V_{1})\mathrm{d}x\tag{7}$$

由于x是小量，即 $x \ll 1$，上式简化为

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}\rho}{\rho^{2}} \approx -\mathrm{d}V_{1} + (V_{1} - V_{2})\mathrm{d}x\tag{8}$$

且

$$\frac{L}{T}\mathrm{d}x \approx \mathrm{d}S_{1}\tag{9}$$

对于水，应有

$$V_{1} \gg V_{2}\tag{10}$$

故

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}p}{\mathrm{d}T} \approx \frac{L}{TV_{1}}\tag{11}$$

而

$$\mathrm{d}\rho \approx \rho^{2}\left(V_{1}\mathrm{d}x - \mathrm{d}V_{1}\right)\tag{12}$$

代入dx则有

$$\mathrm{d}\rho = \rho^{2} \left( \frac{V_{1}T}{L} \mathrm{d}S_{1} - \mathrm{d}V_{1} \right)\tag{13}$$

水蒸气状态方程

$$pV = \frac{m}{M}RT\tag{14}$$

故对单位质量的水蒸气有

$$p V_{1} = \frac{RT}{M}\tag{15}$$

求微分得

$$p \mathrm{d}V_{1} + V_{1} \mathrm{d}p = \frac{R}{M} \mathrm{d}T = \frac{TV_{1}R}{ML} \mathrm{d}p\tag{16}$$

即得

$$\mathrm{d}V_{1}=\left(\frac{RV_{1}T}{ML}-V_{1}\right)\frac{\mathrm{d}p}{p}\tag{17}$$

而对于水蒸气的熵，则有

$$\mathrm{d}S_{1} = c_{p_{1}} \frac{\mathrm{d}T}{T} - \frac{R}{M} \frac{\mathrm{d}p}{p_{1}} = \left( \frac{V_{1}c_{p_{1}}}{L} - \frac{R}{Mp} \right) \mathrm{d}p\tag{18}$$

其中 $c_{p}$ 为水蒸气的比定压摩尔热容

代入得

$$\mathrm{d}\rho = \rho^{2}\left(\frac{V_{1}^{2}c_{p_{1}}T}{L^{2}} + \frac{V_{1}}{p} - 2\frac{RV_{1}T}{MpL}\right)\mathrm{d}p\tag{19}$$

代入 $\rho V_{1} \approx 1$ 与 $\rho = \frac{Mp}{RT}$ 得

$$\mathrm{d}\rho = \left( \frac{M}{RT} + \frac{c_{p_1}T}{L^2} - \frac{2}{L} \right) \mathrm{d}p\tag{20}$$

又由于 $v_{s}=\sqrt{\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial \rho}\right)_{s}}$ (即绝热条件下p对ρ的导数)得

$$v_{s}=\left(\frac{M}{RT}+\frac{c_{p}T}{L^{2}}-\frac{2}{L}\right)^{-\frac{1}{2}}\tag{21}$$

评分标准:

(1)(2)2分；(3)(4)(5)3分；(6)(7)(8)(9)2分；(10)1分；(13)(15)(16)(17)2分；(18)(20)3分；(21)4分；

questions.content:
六、

解析:(1)在介质中，频率为ω的电磁波的电矢量和磁矢量可以写作:

$$
\begin{cases}\vec{E}\left( \vec{r}, t \right) = \vec{E}\left( \vec{r} \right) e^{- i \omega t} \\vec{B}\left( \vec{r}, t \right) = \vec{B}\left( \vec{r} \right) e^{- i \omega t}\end{cases}\tag{1}
$$

$$
\nabla \times \vec { E } = - \frac { \partial \vec { B } } { \partial t }\tag{2}
$$

$$
\nabla \times \left( \nabla \times \vec{E} \right) = - \nabla \times \left( \frac{\partial \vec{B}}{\partial t} \right) = i \omega \mu \vec{\mathrm{J}} + i \omega^2 \varepsilon \mu \frac{\partial \vec{E}}{\partial t}\tag{3}
$$

$$
\nabla \left( \nabla \cdot \vec { E } \right) - \nabla ^ { 2 } \vec { E } = \left( \varepsilon \mu \omega ^ { 2 } + i \omega \mu \sigma \right) \vec { E }\tag{4}
$$

介质中∇·E=0,则

$$
k ^ { 2 } = \varepsilon \mu \omega ^ { 2 } + i \omega \mu _ { 0 } \sigma\tag{5}
$$

(2)由对称性知其传播方向依然沿法线.

$$
\vec { E } = \vec { E } _ { 0 } e ^ { - i \omega t } \cdot e ^ { i \vec { k } \cdot \vec { r } } = \vec { E } _ { 0 } e ^ { - i \omega t } \cdot e ^ { - i \vec { \alpha } \cdot \vec { r } } \cdot e ^ { i \vec { \beta } \cdot \vec { r } }\tag{6}
$$

α, $\vec { \beta }$ 都是实矢量， $\vec { k } = \vec { \beta } + i \vec { \alpha }$ 。对正入射，有 $\vec { \beta }$ 、都沿法线方向，因而由

$$
k^{2} = \beta^{2} - \alpha^{2} + 2i\beta\alpha\tag{7}
$$

得

$$
\beta ^ { 2 } - \alpha ^ { 2 } = \omega ^ { 2 } \varepsilon \mu\tag{8}
$$

$$
\alpha \beta = \frac { \omega \mu \delta } { 2 }\tag{9}
$$

$$
\left\{ \begin{aligned} \alpha^{2} = \frac{\omega^{2} \varepsilon \mu}{2} \left( \sqrt{1 + \left( \frac{\sigma}{\omega \varepsilon} \right)^{2}} - 1 \right) \\ \beta^{2} = \frac{\omega^{2} \varepsilon \mu}{2} \left( \sqrt{1 + \left( \frac{\sigma}{\omega \varepsilon} \right)^{2}} + 1 \right) \end{aligned} \right.\tag{10}
$$

此时的相速度

$$
v = \frac{\omega}{\beta} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon \mu}{2} \sqrt{1 + \left( \frac{\sigma}{\omega \varepsilon} \right)^2 + 1}}}\tag{11}
$$

(3)入射角为θ时，不能再认为β、沿同一方向，此时只能根据边界条件推导 ${ \vec { \beta } }   .$ α。入射波的波矢为

$$
\vec{k} = k \cos \theta \vec{e}_z + k \sin \theta \vec{e}_x\tag{12}
$$

导电介质内的波矢为

$$
\vec { k } ^ { \prime } = \vec { \beta } + i \vec { \alpha } = ( \beta _ { x } + i \alpha _ { x } ) \vec { e } _ { x } + ( \beta _ { z } + i \alpha _ { z } ) \vec { e } _ { z }\tag{13}
$$

由相位在边界上的连续性知

$$
{ k _ { x } } ^ { \prime }   =   k _ { x }\tag{14}
$$

$$
\alpha _ { x } = 0 , \beta _ { x } = k \sin \theta\tag{15}
$$

由 $k^{'2} = \beta^{2} - \alpha^{2}$ +2iαz, βz = ω2εµ +iωµσ得

$$
\alpha _ { z } \beta _ { z } = \omega \mu \sigma\tag{16}
$$

$$
- \alpha _ { z } ^ { 2 } + \beta _ { z } ^ { 2 } + \beta _ { x } ^ { 2 } = \omega ^ { 2 } \varepsilon \mu\tag{17}
$$

得

$$
\alpha_{z}^{2}=\frac{\omega^{2}\varepsilon\mu}{2}\left(\sqrt{\left(1-\frac{k^{2}}{\omega^{2}\varepsilon\mu}\sin^{2}\theta\right)^{2}+\frac{\sigma^{2}}{\omega^{2}\varepsilon^{2}}}-1+\frac{k^{2}}{\omega^{2}\varepsilon\mu}\sin^{2}\theta\right)\tag{18}
$$

$$
\beta_{z}^{2}=\frac{\omega^{2}\varepsilon\mu}{2}\sqrt{\left(1-\frac{k^{2}}{\omega^{2}\varepsilon\mu}\sin^{2}\theta\right)^{2}+\frac{\sigma^{2}}{\omega^{2}\varepsilon^{2}}+1-\frac{k^{2}}{\omega^{2}\varepsilon\mu}\sin^{2}\theta}\tag{19}
$$

于是，透射波的相速度和传播矢量为

(20)

$$
\begin{aligned}y = \frac{\omega}{\sqrt{\beta_{x}^{2} + \beta_{z}^{2}}} = \frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{\left( 1 - \frac{k^{2}}{\omega^{2} \varepsilon \mu} \sin^{2} \theta \right)^{2} + \frac{\sigma^{2}}{\omega^{2} \varepsilon^{2}} + 1 + \frac{k^{2}}{\omega^{2} \varepsilon \mu} \sin^{2} \theta}}}{\frac{\beta_{x} \frac{\sigma}{\varepsilon_{x}}}{\sqrt{\beta_{x}^{2} + \beta_{z}^{2}}} + \frac{\beta_{z} \frac{\sigma}{\varepsilon_{x}}}{\sqrt{\beta_{x}^{2} + \beta_{z}^{2}}}}\end{aligned}\tag{21}
$$

(4)

$$
\nabla \times { \vec { E } } = - { \frac { \partial { \vec { B } } } { \partial t } } = i \omega { \vec { B } }\tag{22}
$$

(36)

得

$$
i \vec { k } \times \vec { E } = i \omega \vec { B }\tag{23}
$$

即

$$
\vec { B } = \frac { 1 } { \omega } \left( \beta _ { z } + i \alpha _ { z } \right) \vec { e } _ { z } \times \vec { E } = \frac { 1 } { \omega } \sqrt { \beta _ { z } ^ { 2 } + \alpha _ { z } ^ { 2 } } e ^ { i \arctan \frac { \alpha _ { z } } { \beta _ { z } } } \vec { e } _ { z } \times \vec { E }\tag{24}
$$

$$
\varphi = \arctan \frac{\alpha_{_z}}{\beta_{_z}}\tag{25}
$$

$\alpha _ { _ { z } } , \beta _ { _ { z } }$ 在之前已经给出；

(5)对良导体

(35)

$$
\alpha_{z}=\sqrt{\frac{\sigma}{\omega \varepsilon} \cdot \frac{\omega^{2} \varepsilon \mu}{2}}=\sqrt{\frac{\omega \mu \sigma}{2}}\tag{26}
$$

$$
v = \frac{\omega}{\beta} = \sqrt{\frac{2\omega}{\mu \sigma}}, \varphi = 45^{\circ}\tag{27}
$$

对绝缘体，

$$
\alpha_{z}=0,\beta_{z}=\sqrt{\omega^{2}\varepsilon\mu\left(1-\frac{k^{2}}{\omega^{2}\varepsilon\mu}\sin^{2}\theta\right)}\tag{28}
$$

$$
v = \frac{\omega}{\sqrt{\beta_{x}^{2} + \beta_{z}^{2}}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\varepsilon \mu}}, \quad \varphi = 0^{\circ}\tag{29}
$$

(6)焦耳热的功率密度

$$
\mathbf{p} = \frac{1}{2} \mathbf{J} \mathbf{E} = \frac{1}{2} \mathbf{\sigma} \mathbf{E}_0^2 \mathbf{e}^{-2 \mathbf{a}_z \mathbf{z}}\tag{30}
$$

金属是良导体，因而

$$
\alpha = \sqrt{\frac{\omega \mu \sigma}{2}} = \sqrt{\pi f \mu \sigma}\tag{31}
$$

$$
P = A \int_{0}^{+ \infty} p dz = \frac{\sigma AE_{0}^{2}}{4 \sqrt{\pi f \mu \sigma}}.
$$

(32)

代入数据得

$$
P = 3 0 . 3 \mathrm { W }\tag{33}
$$

(34)

七、

解析:(1)三段的波函数分别为

$$
\left\{ \begin{aligned} \psi = A e^{i k x} + B e^{-i k x} (x < 0) \\ \psi = E e^{k x} + F e^{-k x} (0 < x < \Delta) \\ \psi = C e^{i k x} + D e^{-i k x} (x > \Delta) \end{aligned} \right.\tag{1}
$$

其中

$$
k   =   \frac { \sqrt { 2 m E } } { \hbar }\tag{2}
$$

$$
k' = \frac{\sqrt{2m\left(V_{0} - E\right)}}{\hbar}\tag{3}
$$

A到F为六个积分常数。

(2)考虑从左向右入射的波，那么D=0。再由边界上的连接条件可得

$$
A + B = E + F\tag{4}
$$

$$
E e ^ { k ^ { \prime } \Delta } + F e ^ { - k ^ { \prime } \Delta } = C e ^ { i k \Delta }\tag{5}
$$

$$
i k ( A - B ) = k ^ { \prime } ( E - F )\tag{6}
$$

$$
k ^ { \prime } \left( E e ^ { k ^ { \prime } \Delta } - F e ^ { - k ^ { \prime } \Delta } \right) = i k C e ^ { i k \Delta }\tag{7}
$$

这几个积分常数物理意义是，A表示左侧入射波，B表示反射回左侧的波，E和F为势场内的波，C为透射过势场的波。最终目标是解出A和C之比。用第(5)(7)两个式子可以用C表示E和F。

$$
E = \frac { C } { - 2 k ^ { \prime } } e ^ { - k ^ { \prime } \Delta + i k \Delta } \left( - k ^ { \prime } - i k \right)\tag{8}
$$

$$
F = \frac { C } { - 2 k ^ { \prime } } e ^ { k ^ { \prime } \Delta + i k \Delta } ( - k ^ { \prime } + i k )\tag{9}
$$

再用(4)(6)式可以用E和F表示A。

$$
\frac{(E + F)(-ik) - k'(E - F)}{-2ik}\tag{10}
$$

再带入E和F，化简可得透射系数为

$$
p = \frac{C}{A} = \frac{2ikk'}{e^{ik\Delta}\left[ \left( 2ikk'coshk'\Delta \right) + \left( \left( k^2 - k^{'2} \right)sinhk'\Delta \right) \right]}\tag{11}
$$

(3)直接积分即可得到

$$
V\left(x^{\prime}\right)-E=E_{g}\left(1-\frac{x^{\prime}}{\Delta x}\right)\left(0<x^{\prime}<\Delta x\right)\tag{12}
$$

$$
P = \exp \left\{ - \frac{2}{\hbar} \int_{x_1}^{x_2} \sqrt{2m(V(x) - E)}   dx \right\} = \exp \left[ - \frac{4}{3} \frac{\sqrt{2mE_g}}{\hbar} \Delta x \right]\tag{13}
$$

可以发现透射概率随势垒长度是负指数的变化关系。

(4)带入数值可得

$$
\Delta x = 3 . 0 6 n m\tag{14}
$$

第(1)问:5分；(1)5分；

第(2)问:25分；(3)-(10)各3分；(11)4分；

第(3)问:6分；(12)2分；(13)4分；

第(4)问:4分；(14)4分；
